messages.subject: Re: 共分散構造分析
parts:
Seongho Bae さんありがとうございます．
デフォルトで両側検定なのはわかりましたが，片側検定の設定方法はどのように行えばいいのですか？
Ｒのプログラムは以下のようになっています．出来れば教えて頂きませんか？
Seongho Bae's Thank you.
Although I understand it the default in a two-tailed test, do you say be carried out how how to set up a one-tailed test?
R of the program looks like the following. Why do not we tell if possible?
###データの読み込み
X <- read.csv("dat/共分散構造分析完成版.csv",row.names=1)
#列名の変更
colnames(X) <- c("x1","x2","x3","x4","x5","x6","x7","x8","x9","x10","x11","x12","x13","x14","x15","x16","x17","x18","x19","x20","x21","x22","x23")
b.cov <- cov(X)
b.cov

model1 <- 'f1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7
    f2 =~ x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14
           f3 =~ x15 + x16
           f4 =~ x17 + x18 + x19 + x20 + x21
           f5 =~ x22 + x23
           f1 ~ f2 + f3 + f5
           f5 ~ f4
           f3 ~ f5
           f2 ~ f4
           x1 ~~ x1
           x2 ~~ x2
           x3 ~~ x3
           x4 ~~ x4
           x5 ~~ x5
           x6 ~~ x6
           x7 ~~ x7
           x8 ~~ x8
           x9 ~~ x9
           x10 ~~ x10
           x11 ~~ x11
           x12 ~~ x12
           x13 ~~ x13
           x14 ~~ x14
           x15 ~~ x15
           x16 ~~ x16  
           x17 ~~ x17
           x18 ~~ x18
           x19 ~~ x19
           x20 ~~ x20
           x21 ~~ x21
           x22 ~~ x22
           x23 ~~ x23
           f1 ~~ f1
           f2 ~~ f2
           f3 ~~ f3
           f4 ~~ f4
           f5 ~~ f5'

#共分散行列を利用
fit.c <- lavaan(model=model1,sample.cov=b.cov,
            sample.nobs=2000,estimator="ML",std.lv=TRUE,std.ov=TRUE,mimic="EQS")

###semPathsによるパス図の描画
semPaths(fit.c, layout = "tree", whatLabels  = "stand", 
nDigits=3, shapeMan="square", sizeMan =4, 
sizeLat =6, sizeLat2 =6, style = "lisrel",
residScale=12, curve=1.5, optimizeLatRes=T,edge.color="blue")

#標準化推定値　共分散データ
standardizedSolution(object=fit.c)

###lavaanで計算できる全ての適合度指標の出力
fitMeasures(fit.c, fit.measures="all")
